what: Independent review of the twelve multi-stage v2 cases before freezing. Two reviewers, six cases each, read only the authoring brief and their cases. Full reports were returned in the controlling session; this records each finding class and how it was resolved.

blocking.finding: rotation_ceiling failed a correct alternative (roll-when-full kept plus the requested pre-append roll); verified by the reviewer on the stage-4 tree
blocking.resolution: check() tolerates an empty trailing segment; exact-fit test dropped; the reviewer's alternative re-run and passing in round 2

blocking.finding: a group required lint behaviour the request never stated, against the documented meaning of lint.redundant-role
fact `bad capacity` quoted a message no request states
groups called start=/end= keywords the request never named
group required format_amount itself to group digits; the request asked only for grouped output
blocking.resolution: request states format_amount groups by default; decimal_amounts checks exact text only where every reading agrees

blocking.finding: later groups called load() with no files although the request gave no default

round_1.systemic: Both reviewers independently found facts with invented keys or free-text values in 10 of 12 cases, which would score careful documentation as stale. AUTHORING.md gained a Fairness section (fact keys must be existing rows or names the request uses; values stated in or fully determined by the request; groups require only stated or existing behaviour, request-given parameter names, no single reading; no indirect leaks such as 'nothing else should change'), and every case was revised against it by its author.
round_1.leaks: marklite 'everywhere' and 'callers'; stockroom and others 'nothing else ... should change'; layered_config 'everything that uses them'; tabulate_report 'and the row count' — all removed.

remaining.finding: key unknown_parameter not named by the request
'KEY_SEPARATOR can go' made the graded removal optional
'when the caller passes a separator' hinted at the dependent
remaining.resolution: reworded to 'when it is given a separator'

round_2.after: All round-2 findings were wording in requests and were applied by the controller (ff3b5ed, 92ec5fd); no group, diff or fact changed, so no third round was run.
